senses.gloss: m. (κατάφρακτος, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Cataphracti) mailed in full armor (on horseback).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:9:4">Cant. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>יצא פרעה ק׳</he> (not <cite ref="S00818"><he>קטפרטקיס</he></cite>) Pharaoh went forth in full armor, so, as it were, did the Lord (<cite ref="Isaiah 42:13">Is. XLII, 13</cite>).
